expected_behavior: Share activation advertises the actual supported image/movie representations and does not offer unsupported arbitrary files as though they can be uploaded.
actual_assertions: Share services activation advertises up to ten images and ten movies
Generic files, text, web pages and web URLs have no activation support declaration
Activation rule is a typed dictionary, with no always-true predicate or generic attachment override
scope: Local plist/resource semantics and direct app-owned Swift API inventory only. E01 separately verifies real built app/share/widget bundles and SDK manifests. This does not claim App Store approval or host share-sheet runtime behavior.
